rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person whose opinions or actions are politically radical.

example.english: That radical is always inciting people at protests.
example.traditional: 嗰個激進分子成日喺示威現場煽動人。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gik1 zeon3 fan6 zi2 seng4 jat6 hai2 si6 wai1 jin6 coeng4 sin3 dung6 jan4
